verdict.rationale: Heap documents its own server-side APIs for tracking events, bulk track, identify, user and account properties, and user deletion. These cover data ingestion, identity, and privacy operations. Nothing in the evidence exposes the UI's core analysis features through an API: charts and reports, retroactive event definition, Sense Chat, session replay, and exports. No OpenAPI spec was found either, so UI parity is far from shown. Missing for 10: API access to querying and reporting, event-definition and dashboard management, session replay and export via API, a published OpenAPI spec, and any explicit parity claim or independent corroboration.
